# Fixture book, chapter 2: concentration

> Part of [book-2019-fixture-book](book-2019-fixture-book.md) · pp. 16–30 · Chapter 2. Concentration

**Problem:** Show that fixture sums concentrate.

**Main result:** Sums of independent fixture variables concentrate.

## Setup & assumptions

A fixture Chernoff bound.

## Proof idea (sketch only)

- The tail decays exponentially.

## Key equations

**Fixture equation:**
$P(S>t)\le e^{-t^2/2}$
Variables: $x$: a fixture variable


## Takeaways

- The tail decays exponentially.
